original_finding_content.subject: Kichink platform status — 403 Forbidden, nominally indexed
original_finding_content.raw_text:
- **Finding ID:** F-X11
- **What:** Kichink.com returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to direct requests but remains indexed by Google with a 2025 copyright footer, active product listings, and a "Crea tu tienda" page advertising 15% commission.
- **Verbatim snippet:** n/a — platform status finding, not seller voice
- **Source:** Direct fetch of `https://www.kichink.com` (403 Forbidden); `site:kichink.com` search results show indexed pages including footer "@2025 Kichink Servicios S.A. de C.V."
- **source_type:** unknown
- **verification_status:** direct_verified
- **Date:** Accessed April 2026
- **Notes:** kichink.com resolves (DNS active) but serves 403 to direct fetch. Google indexes the site with 2025 copyright and active store listings. ZoomInfo shows a Director of Technology hire (Liliana Fernandez) joining October 8, 2025. RocketReach claims $16.9M revenue in 2025 — this figure is likely an automated estimate, not verified financial data. No formal shutdown announcement found. No news coverage of Kichink from 2021 through April 2026.
